finalText:
**Green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Only 3 cases were ever red, all in `orderTotal`. It taxed the pre-discount base, so every order with both a discount and a tax came out high.

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

The other 622 cases had a zero discount or a zero tax, which hid it.

Next: nothing. [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) is the only change.
